explication: JavBoss is a local JAV and video management application. The principal workflow is: a user configures video directories, background scanners index files and generate screenshots, JAV providers enrich recognized works, and the web UI queries the catalog for browsing, tagging, favorites, and playback. Playback is served through browser streams or client-mode MPV. Separate branches support Chrome-extension scraping and magnet downloads through CloudDrive2. The graph reflects sampled runtime files plus capabilities explicitly documented in the README; several handlers and scanners were not directly excerpted.
